deadline.value: December 1, 2026 for Fall 2027. International applicants outside the U.S. are not being considered for Fall 2027; only those already in the U.S. with valid nonimmigrant status.

also.quote: will limit the consideration of international student applications to only those individuals currently in the United States holding valid nonimmigrant status.

app_fee.quote: The application fee for the Neuroscience PhD Program is $55 for domestic applicants and $65 for international applicants.

fee_waiver.value: Waiver codes exist for domestic applicants only; none for international applicants for Fall 2027.
fee_waiver.quote: International applicant fee waiver is not available for Fall 2027 class.

gre_general.value: The GRE is no longer required and submitted scores are not reviewed.
gre_general.quote: Any scores submitted will not be reviewed by the admissions committee.

gre_subject.value: No GRE scores, including the Psychology subject test, are reviewed.
gre_subject.quote: Any scores submitted will not be reviewed by the admissions committee.

supervisor.value: The program pages do not say whether a supervisor must be found before applying.

funding.value: All PhD students receive a living stipend (USD 39,253 in 2026-27), health insurance and tuition waiver for the duration of thesis work, provided progress is satisfactory.
funding.quote: All PhD students in the Neuroscience Program are awarded financial support (living stipend, health insurance and tuition waiver) for the duration of their thesis work, provided their progress is satisfactory.

entry_route.value: A bachelor's degree with at least a 3.0 GPA is the stated requirement.
entry_route.quote: applicants must have a bachelor's degree from a regionally-accredited U.S. college or university or equivalent

notes: International applicants outside the U.S. are not being considered for Fall 2027; only those already in the U.S. with valid nonimmigrant status.
